items.anchor: Ridge spacing is calculated from SAXS data from 8–17 measurements across one wing of each species/subspecies.
items.finding: Iridescent taxa exhibit markedly tighter SAXS ridge spacing (742–929 nm; tightest in H. sara 742 ± 28 nm and co-mimics H. e. cyrbia 812 ± 28 nm / H. m. cythera 823 ± 22 nm) than non-iridescent black sister taxa (1025–1063 nm)
items.method: ESRF ID02 transmission SAXS (0.1 nm X-ray, 20x20 um beam, 30.98 m SDD) across 8–17 positions per wing
items.n: 8–17 measurements across one wing of each species/subspecies

items.anchor: Taxa with lower ridge spacing (higher ridge density) have higher peak reflectance.
items.finding: Iridescent H. erato cyrbia has 23.6% narrower SAXS ridge spacing than non-iridescent H. erato demophoon (812 ± 28 vs 1063 ± 39 nm)
items.method: SAXS ridge spacing comparison between iridescent H. erato cyrbia and non-iridescent sister race H. erato demophoon (Table 1)
items.n: 13 positions (H. e. cyrbia) vs 9 positions (H. e. demophoon) on one wing each

items.anchor: Co-mimetic pairs H. e. cyrbia/ H. m. cythera and H. eleuchia/H. cydno have similar ridge density.
items.finding: Iridescent H. melpomene cythera has 19.7% narrower SAXS ridge spacing than non-iridescent H. melpomene rosina (823 ± 22 vs 1025 ± 82 nm)
items.method: SAXS ridge spacing comparison between iridescent H. melpomene cythera and non-iridescent sister race H. melpomene rosina (Table 1)
items.n: 8 positions (H. m. cythera) vs 18 positions (H. m. rosina) on one wing each

items.anchor: Taxa with lower ridge spacing (higher ridge density) have higher peak reflectance.

items.method: Reciprocal spatial frequency rho = 1/d derived from Table 1 SAXS ridge spacing

items.anchor: ridge reflectors were much more densely packed in H. sara (ridge spacing at 723 nm) and H. erato cyrbia (887 nm)

items.anchor: Scanning electron micrographs show one representative region for each species. White bars are 1 µm.

items.anchor: we established that a biallelic deletion spanning 82/97 bp across the lncRNA first exon is sufficient to generate a strong ivory phenotype

items.anchor: produced F 1 individuals, again displaying no pigmentation changes on their wings ( Fig. 3 I and I ’ ).

items.anchor: Together, these results rule out a function for cortex in V. cardui wing scale pigmentation.

items.method: Abaxial vs adaxial microspectrophotometry across 39 scales from 34 butterfly species

items.anchor: we detected an increase in the mean distance between crossribs (dWT = 862 ± 71 nm versus dG8 = 1160 ± 116 nm)
items.finding: Artificial selection for violet-blue ground scale color increased mean crossrib spacing from 862 ± 71 nm (WT) to 1160 ± 116 nm (G8)
items.method: FIB-SEM ultrastructural measurement across WT and G8 selected B. anynana lines

items.anchor: The increase in the distance between crossribs increased the mean window area (Figure S3D) (areaWT = 0.72 ± 0.2 μm2 versus areaG8 = 1.2 ± 0.3 μm2)
items.finding: Mean window area increased from 0.72 ± 0.2 um2 (WT) to 1.2 ± 0.3 um2 (G8) alongside wider crossrib spacing
items.method: FIB-SEM measurement of upper-lamina window area across WT and G8 selected B. anynana ground scales

items.anchor: a significant positive correlation (intercept: 117.13, β = 0.76, SE = 0.22, t = 3.51, p = 3.1e-03)
items.finding: Shorter ridges (268–1036 nm, n = 17 scales) positively correlate with peak reflectance wavelength (PGLS β = 0.76 ± 0.22, t = 3.51, p = 3.1e-03)
items.method: Transverse FIB-SEM ridge height measurement and PGLS regression across shorter-ridge cohort (268–1036 nm)

items.anchor: This positive correlation was very significant for taller ridges between 1126 and 2184 nm (intercept: −554.08, β = 4.57, SE = 0.40, t = 11.54, p < 1e-04)
items.contrast: {"kind": "pair", "fields": [], "confound": false, "balanced": null, "problems": ["groups cohort_order2 and cohort_order1 have identical context: no field differs"], "aliased": false, "benchmark": false, "linked": []}
items.finding: 39 scales across 34 species stratify into two constructive-interference ridge-height branches — 268–1036 nm (mean 614 nm, p = 3.1e-3) and 1126–2184 nm (mean 1444 nm, β = 4.57, t = 11.54, p < 1e-4)
items.method: Transverse FIB-SEM ridge height measurement and PGLS regression across 39 scale types in 34 species
items.n: 17 lower-branch and 21 upper-branch scales (plus 1 third-order outlier = 39 total)

items.anchor: constructive interference of the two waves gives rise to spectral peaks, whose wavelengths/hues (λ) are given by
items.finding: A chitin ridge of height h = 400 nm (n_r = 1.56 in air n_a = 1.0) at order m = 1 (i = 2) produces a blue interference peak at 448 nm
items.method: Analytical ridge-air phase interference equation lambda = 2*(n_r - n_a)*h / m

items.anchor: SEM top view of scale after milling of two consecutive ridges (core + lamellae).
items.finding: Image-derived SEM ridge spacing on intact Morpho didius cover scale (Fig 5C) is 0.763 um (FFT) / 0.760 um (transect)
items.method: LivingLit 2D FFT and multi-transect profiling on Fig 5C intact Morpho didius SEM

items.anchor: We found that the reflection spectrum was UV-shifted when the ridge height was decreased
items.finding: Progressive full-ridge FIB milling (z = 100, 500, 800 nm) UV-shifts the Morpho didius reflectance peak from 435 nm down to 411 nm, 369 nm, and 350 nm while reducing brightness
items.method: FIB-SEM milling of full ridge (core + lamellae) followed by microspectrophotometry (Fig 5C')

items.anchor: We found that the position of the reflectance peak (∼430 nm) remained unchanged regardless of the depth of milling
items.finding: Selective lateral lamellae milling up to z = 1000 nm leaves the ~430 nm peak wavelength unchanged (digitized 438 -> 435 -> 432 nm) while halving peak reflectance intensity (76% -> 36%)
items.method: Selective FIB-SEM milling of lateral lamellae only (preserving central ridge core) followed by microspectrophotometry (Fig 5D')

field_decls.name: taxon
field_decls.scope: Lepidoptera phylogenetic tree spanning butterflies (Papilionoidea) and moths (Bombycoidea, Noctuoidea, Geometroidea, Pyraloidea, Saturniidae, Sphingidae, Uraniidae…) with pinned NCBITaxon xrefs.

field_decls.name: sex
field_decls.scope: specimen biological sex (male, female, male and female).

field_decls.name: anatomical_region
field_decls.scope: Anatomical body or wing region sampled (wing -> forewing/hindwing -> dorsal/ventral, margin/discal; plus thorax, abdomen, antenna, leg for moth acoustic/thermal scales).

field_decls.name: pattern_element
field_decls.scope: Homologous Nymphalid Groundplan (NGP) symmetry element, eyespot, band, wing compartment, or moth camouflage/acoustic zone.

field_decls.name: scale_type
field_decls.scope: Homologous scale layer and specialization tree (cover, ground, UVI, spatulate, androconia, transparent/glass, piliform hair-like, thoracic acoustic scale).

field_decls.name: functional_architecture
field_decls.scope: Extensible physical/chemical mechanism hierarchy: optical structural (ridge multilayer, lower-lamina thin film, inter-ridge honeycomb, 3D gyroid, cross-rib diffuser), pigmentary (melanin, pterin, ommochrome, papiliochrome, bile), acoustic (ultrasonic broadband absorber, resonant lamina), thermal and wetting (radiative cooler, superhydrophobic microtexture).

field_decls.name: life_stage
field_decls.scope: organismal developmental stage at sampling (egg, larva, pupa, adult).

field_decls.name: pupal_stage_pct
field_decls.scope: normalized percentage of total pupal development (% APF) at sampling or live imaging.

field_decls.name: target_gene
field_decls.scope: Hierarchical homologous developmental gene, transcription factor, signaling pathway, pigment enzyme, cytoskeletal complex, or non-coding regulator targeted or profiled (with pinned FlyBase FBgn / OrthoDB ortholog xrefs).

field_decls.name: genetic_element_type
field_decls.scope: Class of genomic element perturbed or profiled (coding exon, cis-regulatory element such as enhancer/promoter/silencer, non-coding RNA such as lncRNA/miRNA, chromosomal inversion, or transgene reporter).

field_decls.name: allele_or_zygosity
field_decls.scope: Genetic zygosity or perturbation state (wild type, G0 somatic mosaic, heterozygous, homozygous null, dominant gain-of-function, RNAi knockdown, or natural polymorphism).

field_decls.name: perturbation_modality
field_decls.scope: Experimental or evolutionary perturbation design (wild type, G0 CRISPR mosaic, germline knockout, CRE deletion, RNAi knockdown, transgenesis, artificial selection, small-molecule inhibitor, FIB milling, mechanical ablation, thermal/humidity shift, vehicle control).

field_decls.name: chemical_agent
field_decls.scope: pharmacological inhibitor, pigment precursor, or vehicle solvent (with pinned ChEBI xrefs).

field_decls.name: imaging_modality
field_decls.scope: Hierarchical microscopy (SEM, FIB-SEM, TEM, confocal, TauSTED, SIM, AFM, optical, UV photography, immunofluorescence, HCR in situ), scattering (SAXS, USAXS), spectroscopy (microspectrophotometry, goniometry, Raman, FTIR), acoustic (ultrasound vibrometry), or genomics/transcriptomics (bulk RNA-seq, scRNA-seq, snRNA-seq, ChIP-seq, CUT&Tag, ATAC-seq, WGS/GWAS, QTL mapping).

field_decls.name: view_orientation
field_decls.scope: Viewing geometry relative to scale plane (planar apical top-down, tilted oblique, cross-section, 3D volumetric).

field_decls.name: hydration_and_prep
field_decls.scope: Cuticle hydration state and specimen preparation (live in vivo, fixed hydrated, dry native, vacuum sputter-coated, FIB-milled, critical-point dried).

field_decls.name: measure
field_decls.scope: quantitative morphological, developmental, biomechanical, optical, acoustic, thermal, or genomic trait.

terms.definition: True butterflies superfamily within Lepidoptera.
terms.label: Papilionoidea
terms.scope: Root butterfly clade encompassing Nymphalidae, Pieridae, Papilionidae, Lycaenidae, and Riodinidae.

terms.definition: Brush-footed butterflies family within Papilionoidea.
terms.label: Nymphalidae
terms.scope: Used for Heliconius, Vanessa, Bicyclus, Morpho, and other nymphalid taxa, distinct from Pieridae and Papilionidae.

terms.definition: Sulphur and white butterflies family within Papilionoidea.
terms.label: Pieridae
terms.scope: Used for Colias and other pierid butterflies utilizing pterin pigments and UV-iridescent ridge gratings, distinct from Nymphalidae and Papilionidae.

terms.definition: Swallowtail butterflies family within Papilionoidea.
terms.label: Papilionidae
terms.scope: Used for Parides and Papilio swallowtails, distinct from Nymphalidae and Pieridae.

terms.definition: Longwing subfamily of Nymphalidae.
terms.label: Heliconiinae
terms.scope: Used for Heliconius mimicry rings, distinct from Nymphalinae, Satyrinae, and Morphinae.

terms.definition: Nymphaline subfamily including painted ladies and admirals.
terms.label: Nymphalinae
terms.scope: Used for Vanessa cardui, distinct from Heliconiinae, Satyrinae, and Morphinae.

terms.definition: Satyrine subfamily including eyespot model butterflies.
terms.label: Satyrinae
terms.scope: Used for Bicyclus anynana, distinct from Heliconiinae, Nymphalinae, and Morphinae.

terms.definition: Morphine subfamily known for tall multi-lamellar ridge reflectors.
terms.label: Morphinae
terms.scope: Used for Morpho species, distinct from Heliconiinae, Nymphalinae, and Satyrinae.

terms.definition: Sulphur butterfly subfamily within Pieridae.
terms.label: Coliadinae
terms.scope: Used for Colias sulphur butterflies.

terms.definition: True swallowtail subfamily within Papilionidae.
terms.label: Papilioninae
terms.scope: Used for Parides cattleheart swallowtails.

terms.definition: Neotropical Mullerian mimicry genus Heliconius.
terms.label: Heliconius
terms.scope: Genus parent for H. sara, H. erato, H. melpomene, H. cydno, and H. eleuchia.

terms.definition: Cosmopolitan nymphaline genus Vanessa.
terms.label: Vanessa
terms.scope: Genus parent for Vanessa cardui.

terms.definition: Afrotropical satyrine bushbrown genus Bicyclus.
terms.label: Bicyclus
terms.scope: Genus parent for Bicyclus anynana.

terms.definition: Neotropical structural-blue genus Morpho.
terms.label: Morpho
terms.scope: Genus parent for Morpho helenor and Morpho didius.

terms.definition: Clouded yellow / sulphur genus Colias.
terms.label: Colias
terms.scope: Genus parent for Colias eurytheme.

terms.definition: Neotropical Troidini swallowtail genus Parides.
terms.label: Parides
terms.scope: Genus parent for Parides eurimedes and Parides iphidamas.

terms.definition: Sara longwing butterfly exhibiting proximal dorsal blue structural iridescence.
terms.label: Heliconius sara
terms.scope: Distinct from H. erato, H. melpomene, H. cydno, and H. eleuchia.

terms.definition: Red postman butterfly species with structurally iridescent and non-iridescent geographic subspecies.
terms.label: Heliconius erato
terms.scope: Species parent for H. erato cyrbia and H. erato demophoon, distinct from H. sara and H. melpomene.

terms.definition: Postman butterfly species co-mimicking H. erato across Neotropical races.
terms.label: Heliconius melpomene
terms.scope: Species parent for H. melpomene cythera and H. melpomene rosina, distinct from H. erato and H. sara.

terms.definition: Iridescent blue-black Heliconius species in the sara/sapho clade.
terms.label: Heliconius eleuchia
terms.scope: Distinct from H. sara, H. cydno, H. erato, and H. melpomene.

terms.definition: Cydno longwing species exhibiting moderate blue structural reflectance.
terms.label: Heliconius cydno
terms.scope: Distinct from H. melpomene, H. sara, and H. eleuchia.

terms.definition: Painted lady butterfly model system for live in vivo pupal scale morphogenesis.
terms.label: Vanessa cardui
terms.scope: Sole Vanessa species in the current corpus.

terms.definition: Squinting bushbrown model butterfly for wing eyespot patterning and artificial color selection.
terms.label: Bicyclus anynana
terms.scope: Sole Bicyclus species in the current corpus.

terms.definition: Helenor morpho butterfly with high-aspect-ratio multi-lamellar ridge reflectors.
terms.label: Morpho helenor
terms.scope: Sole Morpho species explicitly benchmarked.

terms.definition: Orange sulphur butterfly exhibiting male-specific UV iridescence controlled by Doublesex and Bric-a-brac.
terms.label: Colias eurytheme
terms.scope: Sole Colias species in the current corpus.

terms.definition: Mylotes cattleheart swallowtail with green honeycomb photonic scales.
terms.label: Parides eurimedes
terms.scope: Distinct from sister species Parides iphidamas.

terms.definition: Transandean cattleheart swallowtail with green crossrib-honeycomb scales.
terms.label: Parides iphidamas
terms.scope: Distinct from sister species Parides eurimedes.

terms.definition: Western Ecuadorian iridescent blue race of Heliconius erato.
terms.label: Heliconius erato cyrbia
terms.scope: Iridescent subspecies, distinct from non-iridescent Panamanian H. erato demophoon.

terms.definition: Central American non-iridescent black race of Heliconius erato.
terms.label: Heliconius erato demophoon
terms.scope: Non-iridescent sister race to H. erato cyrbia.

terms.definition: Western Ecuadorian iridescent co-mimic race of Heliconius melpomene.
terms.label: Heliconius melpomene cythera
terms.scope: Iridescent subspecies co-mimicking H. e. cyrbia, distinct from non-iridescent H. m. rosina.

terms.definition: Central American non-iridescent black race of Heliconius melpomene.
terms.label: Heliconius melpomene rosina
terms.scope: Non-iridescent sister race to H. m. cythera.

terms.definition: Adult or developing male butterfly.
terms.label: male
terms.scope: Distinct from female.

terms.definition: Adult or developing female butterfly.
terms.label: female
terms.scope: Distinct from male.

terms.definition: Lepidopteran wing appendage (forewing or hindwing, dorsal or ventral).
terms.label: wing
terms.scope: Root anatomical wing term.

terms.definition: Mesothoracic anterior wing.
terms.label: forewing
terms.scope: Distinct from metathoracic hindwing and unspecified dorsal/ventral wing.

terms.definition: Metathoracic posterior wing.
terms.label: hindwing
terms.scope: Distinct from mesothoracic forewing.

terms.definition: Upper (dorsal) wing surface across fore- or hindwing.
terms.label: dorsal wing
terms.scope: Used when dorsal side is specified across both wing pairs, distinct from ventral wing.

terms.definition: Lower (ventral) wing surface across fore- or hindwing.
terms.label: ventral wing
terms.scope: Used when ventral side is specified across both wing pairs, distinct from dorsal wing.

terms.definition: Upper (dorsal) surface of the forewing.
terms.label: dorsal forewing
terms.scope: Distinct from ventral forewing.

terms.definition: Lower (ventral) surface of the forewing.
terms.label: ventral forewing
terms.scope: Distinct from dorsal forewing.

terms.definition: Upper (dorsal) surface of the hindwing.
terms.label: dorsal hindwing
terms.scope: Distinct from ventral hindwing.

terms.definition: Lower (ventral) surface of the hindwing.
terms.label: ventral hindwing
terms.scope: Distinct from dorsal hindwing.

terms.definition: Homologous topological zone or Nymphalid Groundplan (NGP) symmetry element.
terms.label: wing pattern compartment
terms.scope: Root wing pattern homology node.

terms.definition: Basal and proximal wing zone near the thorax.
terms.label: proximal wing field
terms.scope: Distinct from medial patch, central symmetry band, discal spot, eyespot, and marginal band.

terms.definition: WntA/Optix-patterned central and basal symmetry system bands (CSS/BSS).
terms.label: central symmetry system band
terms.scope: Distinct from discal spot, border ocelli/eyespot, and marginal band.

terms.definition: Pattern element centered on the discal crossvein.
terms.label: discal spot
terms.scope: Distinct from central symmetry band, medial patch, and border ocelli.

terms.definition: Central/medial wing blade color patch.
terms.label: medial wing patch
terms.scope: Distinct from proximal wing field, discal spot, eyespot, and marginal band.

terms.definition: Distal non-marginal wing blade region.
terms.label: distal wing field
terms.scope: Distinct from proximal wing field, medial patch, eyespot, and marginal band.

terms.definition: Homologous NGP border ocellus (eyespot) organ.
terms.label: eyespot field
terms.scope: Parent for eyespot focus and concentric eyespot rings, distinct from CSS band and marginal band.

terms.definition: Central organizer signaling focus of a border eyespot.
terms.label: eyespot focus
terms.scope: Signaling center within an eyespot, distinct from surrounding eyespot rings.

terms.definition: Concentric differentiated color rings surrounding an eyespot focus.
terms.label: eyespot ring
terms.scope: Distinct from the central eyespot focus.

terms.definition: Distalmost wing margin and parafocal border band.
terms.label: marginal band
terms.scope: Distinct from eyespot field, distal sector, and medial patch.

terms.definition: Chitinous single-cell epithelial appendage on the lepidopteran wing.
terms.label: wing scale
terms.scope: Root scale homology term.

terms.definition: Apical overlay scale layer exposed on the wing surface.
terms.label: cover scale
terms.scope: Overlies ground scales; parent for specialized cover scale subtypes.

terms.definition: Basal understory scale layer beneath cover scales.
terms.label: ground scale
terms.scope: Distinct from overlying cover scales.

terms.definition: Typical scalloped ~2 um pitch pigmentary cover scale.
terms.label: canonical cover scale
terms.scope: Standard cover scale morphology, distinct from specialized UVI and spatulate cover scales.

terms.definition: Specialized ~1 um dense-ridge UV-iridescent cover scale.
terms.label: UVI cover scale
terms.scope: High-ridge-density iridescent cover scale, distinct from canonical and spatulate cover scales.

terms.definition: Male-specific rounded margin cover scale with wide ~4.4 um ridge spacing.
terms.label: spatulate cover scale
terms.scope: Wide-ridge marginal cover scale, distinct from canonical and UVI cover scales.

terms.definition: Physical photonic nanostructure or chemical pigment class generating scale appearance.
terms.label: scale coloration mechanism
terms.scope: Root optical/coloration mechanism.

terms.definition: Sub-wavelength chitin-air photonic nanostructure producing constructive interference.
terms.label: structural reflector
terms.scope: Parent for 1D/2D/3D photonic scale architectures, distinct from pigmentary absorber.

terms.definition: Broadband or selective light absorption by embedded chemical pigments without coherent iridescence.
terms.label: non-iridescent pigmentary
terms.scope: Parent for melanin and pterin pigmentary scales, distinct from structural reflector.

terms.definition: Dense longitudinal ridges and overlapping ridge-lamellae acting as multilayer / Bragg interference reflectors.
terms.label: ridge-lamellar reflector
terms.scope: Used for Heliconius, Morpho, and Colias UVI ridge reflectors, distinct from lower-lamina thin films and inter-ridge honeycombs.

terms.definition: Thin-film interference from the basal chitinous lower lamina modulated by ridge/crossrib windows.
terms.label: lower-lamina thin film
terms.scope: Used for Bicyclus ground scales, distinct from ridge-lamellar reflectors and 3D honeycombs.

terms.definition: Tall crossrib-perforated alveolar/honeycomb lumen lattice between ridges.
terms.label: inter-ridge honeycomb lattice
terms.scope: Used for Parides green scales templated by Arp2/3 actin, distinct from ridge-lamellar multilayers and flat lower-lamina thin films.

terms.definition: Melanin-infused dark brown/black non-iridescent scales.
terms.label: melanic pigmentary
terms.scope: Melanin absorber, distinct from pterin/ommochrome pigmentary scales.

terms.definition: Pterin-granule (xanthopterin/leucopterin) yellow/orange scales in Pieridae.
terms.label: pterin pigmentary
terms.scope: Pterin absorber/scatterer, distinct from melanic pigmentary scales.

terms.definition: Pre-pupal caterpillar instar.
terms.label: larva
terms.scope: Distinct from pupa and adult.

terms.definition: Metamorphic pupal stage (chrysalis) during wing and scale morphogenesis.
terms.label: pupa
terms.scope: Distinct from larva and adult.

terms.definition: Fully eclosed imago with dried sclerotized chitinous scales.
terms.label: adult
terms.scope: Distinct from larva and pupa.

terms.definition: Sex-determination transcription factor controlling sexually dimorphic wing patterns and UVI scales.
terms.label: Doublesex (Dsx)
terms.scope: Distinct from downstream Bric-a-brac and Wnt pathway genes.

terms.definition: BTB/POZ transcription factor repressing UV-iridescent ridge ultrastructure downstream of Dsx.
terms.label: Bric-a-brac (Bab)
terms.scope: Distinct from Doublesex and Optix.

terms.definition: Wnt planar cell polarity / canonical receptor required for eyespot focus number and scale orientation.
terms.label: frizzled4 (fz4)
terms.scope: Distinct from Wingless/Wnt1, WntA, and Armadillo.

terms.definition: Canonical Wnt morphogen expressed in wing margin and eyespot foci.
terms.label: Wnt1 / Wingless
terms.scope: Distinct from WntA and frizzled4.

terms.definition: Symmetry-system Wnt ligand patterning central and basal wing bands.
terms.label: WntA
terms.scope: Distinct from canonical Wnt1/Wingless.

terms.definition: Nuclear effector of canonical Wnt signaling in eyespot foci.
terms.label: Armadillo / beta-catenin
terms.scope: Distinct from upstream Wnt ligands and frizzled4.

terms.definition: Sine oculis homeobox transcription factor regulating wing color and lamina/band identity.
terms.label: Optix
terms.scope: Distinct from Dsx and Bab.

terms.definition: Branched actin nucleating complex templating inter-ridge honeycomb height.
terms.label: Arp2/3 complex
terms.scope: Branched actin nucleator inhibited by CK-666, distinct from linear F-actin bundles.

terms.definition: Longitudinal linear filamentous actin bundles pre-patterning ridge spacing and preventing ridge buckling waviness.
terms.label: F-actin bundles
terms.scope: Linear actin cables disrupted by Cytochalasin D, distinct from branched Arp2/3 complex.

terms.definition: Somatic Cas9/sgRNA embryonic microinjection generating mosaic crispant wings.
terms.label: CRISPR G0 mosaic knockout
terms.scope: Distinct from artificial selection, small-molecule inhibition, and vehicle control.

terms.definition: Multi-generation laboratory selection on quantitative spectral hue or pattern traits.
terms.label: artificial directional selection
terms.scope: Distinct from single-gene CRISPR knockout and chemical inhibition.

terms.definition: Stage-timed microinjection of a small-molecule cytoskeletal inhibitor into developing pupae.
terms.label: pharmacological pupal injection
terms.scope: Distinct from solvent vehicle control and genetic knockouts.

terms.definition: Stage-matched sham/solvent (DMSO or ethanol) pupal injection control.
terms.label: solvent vehicle control
terms.scope: Matched reference group for small-molecule inhibitor injections.

terms.definition: Fungal toxin capping barbed F-actin ends and disrupting linear actin polymerization.
terms.label: cytochalasin D
terms.scope: Inhibits linear F-actin, distinct from Arp2/3-specific CK-666 and vehicle solvents.

terms.definition: Small-molecule allosteric inhibitor stabilizing the inactive conformation of the Arp2/3 complex.
terms.label: CK-666
terms.scope: Inhibits branched Arp2/3 actin, distinct from Cytochalasin D and vehicle solvents.

terms.definition: Carrier solvent (DMSO or ethanol in Grace's/PBS buffer) injected into control pupae.
terms.label: DMSO / ethanol vehicle
terms.scope: Control solvent, distinct from active inhibitors CK-666 and Cytochalasin D.

terms.definition: High-resolution electron-beam ultrastructural imaging.
terms.label: electron microscopy
terms.scope: Parent for planar SEM and FIB-SEM, distinct from X-ray, probe, optical, and spectroscopic methods.

terms.definition: Scanning electron microscopy of scale surfaces or freeze/razor-fractured cross-sections.
terms.label: SEM
terms.scope: Distinct from focused-ion-beam milled FIB-SEM.

terms.definition: Focused ion beam milling coupled with scanning electron microscopy for precision cross-sections.
terms.label: FIB-SEM
terms.scope: Distinct from standard planar/fracture SEM.

terms.definition: Synchrotron X-ray reciprocal-space scattering or real-space nanotomography.
terms.label: X-ray scattering & tomography
terms.scope: Parent for SAXS and X-ray nano-tomography, distinct from electron and optical microscopy.

terms.definition: Transmission small-angle X-ray scattering measuring ensemble-averaged Bragg ridge pitch.
terms.label: SAXS
terms.scope: Reciprocal-space diffraction, distinct from real-space X-ray nano-tomography.

terms.definition: 3D synchrotron phase-contrast X-ray nanotomography.
terms.label: X-ray nano-tomography
terms.scope: Real-space 3D X-ray imaging, distinct from SAXS.

terms.definition: Atomic force / scanning probe surfaceprofilometry.
terms.label: AFM/SPM
terms.scope: Contact/tapping probe topography, distinct from electron, X-ray, and optical modalities.

terms.definition: Visible/laser light, fluorescence, super-resolution, or quantitative phase microscopy.
terms.label: optical microscopy
terms.scope: Parent for brightfield, confocal, 3D-SIM, reflection phase, and HCR imaging.

terms.definition: Reflected/transmitted brightfield or epi-illumination wing photography.
terms.label: light microscopy
terms.scope: Distinct from fluorescence confocal, 3D-SIM, reflection phase, and HCR.

terms.definition: Laser-scanning confocal fluorescence microscopy.
terms.label: confocal
terms.scope: Diffraction-limited optical sectioning, distinct from 3D-SIM, phase microscopy, and brightfield.

terms.definition: 3D structured illumination super-resolution fluorescence microscopy.
terms.label: 3D-SIM
terms.scope: Super-resolution fluorescence, distinct from standard confocal and reflection phase microscopy.

terms.definition: Label-free interferometric / speckle-correlation quantitative phase height imaging of live pupal scales.
terms.label: reflection phase microscopy
terms.scope: Label-free nanometric height profilometry, distinct from fluorescence confocal and 3D-SIM.

terms.definition: Hybridization chain reaction (HCR3.0) mRNA in situ and immunohistochemistry imaging.
terms.label: HCR/in situ
terms.scope: Spatial transcript/protein mapping, distinct from structural phase and brightfield microscopy.

terms.definition: UV-vis reflectance spectroscopy (integrating sphere, bifurcated probe, or microspectrophotometer).
terms.label: microspectrophotometry
terms.scope: Spectral reflectance measurement, distinct from spatial imaging modalities.

terms.definition: Orthographic or normal-incidence measurement perpendicular to the scale lamina.
terms.label: planar normal view
terms.scope: Unforeshortened lateral pitch geometry; parent for top-down apical and whole-mount, distinct from tilted oblique and vertical/3D.

terms.definition: Normal-incidence apical surface view of individual scales.
terms.label: top-down apical
terms.scope: Distinct from whole-mount wing transmission/epi view.

terms.definition: Intact wing or whole-scale normal-incidence geometry (e.g. transmission SAXS or whole-wing imaging).
terms.label: whole-mount
terms.scope: Distinct from isolated single-scale top-down apical micrographs.

terms.definition: Oblique stage-tilted viewing geometry introducing cos(theta) lateral pitch foreshortening.
terms.label: tilted oblique
terms.scope: Must never be pooled directly with planar_apical lateral pitch without cos(theta) correction.

terms.definition: Geometry resolving vertical z-height (ridge height, honeycomb height, lamina thickness).
terms.label: vertical cross-section or 3D
terms.scope: Parent for 2D physical cross-sections and 3D volumetric reconstructions, distinct from planar_apical and tilted_oblique.

terms.definition: Transverse physical section perpendicular to longitudinal ridges (FIB-SEM or fracture SEM).
terms.label: cross-section
terms.scope: 2D transverse slice, distinct from non-destructive 3D volumetric stacks.

terms.definition: 3D optical/X-ray/phase reconstruction resolving z-height across an area.
terms.label: 3D volumetric
terms.scope: Non-destructive 3D stack, distinct from milled 2D cross-section.

terms.definition: Aqueous physiological or fixed hydrated state prior to adult desiccation shrinkage.
terms.label: hydrated pupal/fixed state
terms.scope: Parent for live in vivo and fixed hydrated tissues, distinct from dehydrated adult cuticle.

terms.definition: Intact living pupa imaged through a surgical cuticle/coverslip window.
terms.label: live in vivo
terms.scope: Unfixed living state, distinct from fixed and stained hydrated tissue.

terms.definition: Aldehyde-fixed, buffer-mounted fluorescently stained developing wing tissue.
terms.label: fixed and stained
terms.scope: Fixed aqueous state, distinct from live in vivo.

terms.definition: Dehydrated adult chitinous cuticle (after ~20-25% post-eclosion drying contraction).
terms.label: dry sclerotized state
terms.scope: Parent for dry native, vacuum sputter coated, and FIB milled adult scales, distinct from hydrated state.

terms.definition: Uncoated dry adult wing or isolated scale in air (SAXS, AFM, spectroscopy).
terms.label: dry mounted
terms.scope: Uncoated dry cuticle, distinct from metal sputter-coated or FIB-milled samples.

terms.definition: Au/Pd or Pt conductive sputter-coated scale under high-vacuum SEM.
terms.label: sputter coated
terms.scope: Conductive metal-coated dry sample, distinct from uncoated dry native and FIB milled.

terms.definition: Gallium/plasma focused-ion-beam trenched cross-section in vacuum.
terms.label: FIB milled
terms.scope: Ion-milled cross-section, distinct from intact sputter-coated surface SEM and dry native.

terms.definition: Center-to-center lateral period (pitch d) between adjacent longitudinal scale ridges.
terms.label: ridge spacing
terms.scope: Distinct from crossrib spacing, actin bundle spacing, and ridge width.

terms.definition: Spatial frequency of longitudinal ridges per unit width (rho = 1/d).
terms.label: ridge density
terms.scope: Reciprocal of ridge spacing, distinct from ridge number per scale.

terms.definition: Vertical elevation of longitudinal ridges from base/lower lamina to ridge crest.
terms.label: ridge height
terms.scope: Distinct from honeycomb lattice height and lower lamina thickness.

terms.definition: Lateral full width of an individual longitudinal ridge.
terms.label: ridge width
terms.scope: Distinct from center-to-center ridge spacing.

terms.definition: Local in-plane bending curvature kappa (um^-1) of longitudinal ridges.
terms.label: ridge curvature
terms.scope: Quantifies Euler buckling waviness after actin disruption, distinct from ridge density.

terms.definition: Total count of parallel longitudinal ridges spanning a scale's width.
terms.label: ridge number
terms.scope: Whole-scale count, distinct from ridge density.

terms.definition: Longitudinal center-to-center distance between adjacent transverse crossribs.
terms.label: crossrib spacing
terms.scope: Orthogonal to ridge spacing.

terms.definition: Vertical thickness of the crossrib alveolar/honeycomb wall lattice between ridges.
terms.label: honeycomb lattice height
terms.scope: Distinct from total ridge height and lower lamina thickness.

terms.definition: Vertical thickness of the basal chitinous lower lamina.
terms.label: lower lamina thickness
terms.scope: Distinct from ridge height and honeycomb lattice height.

terms.definition: Maximum transverse width of a single wing scale blade.
terms.label: scale width
terms.scope: Distinct from scale area and ridge spacing.

terms.definition: Total planar projected surface area of a single wing scale.
terms.label: scale area
terms.scope: 2D area, distinct from linear scale width.

terms.definition: Center-to-center spacing L between adjacent longitudinal F-actin bundles in pupal scales.
terms.label: actin bundle spacing
terms.scope: Intracellular cytoskeletal pre-pattern pitch, distinct from cuticular ridge spacing.

terms.definition: Transverse diameter of individual pupal F-actin bundles.
terms.label: actin bundle width
terms.scope: Distinct from actin bundle spacing.

terms.definition: Dimensionless threshold compressive growth strain g_c initiating plasma membrane buckling.
terms.label: critical buckling strain
terms.scope: Dimensionless mechanical threshold.

terms.definition: Peak percentage or amplitude of reflected light across the UV-vis spectrum.
terms.label: maximum reflectance
terms.scope: Spectral intensity %, distinct from peak reflectance wavelength.

terms.definition: Spectral wavelength lambda_max (nm) of maximum constructive interference reflectance.
terms.label: peak reflectance wavelength
terms.scope: Spectral hue position, distinct from maximum reflectance amplitude.

terms.definition: Post-pupation time (h/d APF or % pupal development) at which a morphogenetic transition occurs.
terms.label: developmental milestone timing
terms.scope: Temporal developmental landmark.

terms.definition: Normalized percentage of total pupal development (% APF) elapsed at sampling.
terms.label: relative pupal development
terms.scope: Temperature-normalized % pupal timeline, distinct from raw hours APF.

terms.definition: Number of mosaic crispant individuals differentiating supernumerary eyespot foci.
terms.label: eyespot duplication count
terms.scope: Phenotypic penetrance count, distinct from scale orientation defect count.

terms.definition: Number of crispant individuals showing planar cell polarity scale rotation defects.
terms.label: scale orientation defect count
terms.scope: PCP penetrance count, distinct from eyespot duplication count.

terms.definition: Number of G0 CRISPR mosaic individuals exhibiting variegated wing pattern transformation.
terms.label: crispant wing phenotype count
terms.scope: Mosaic penetrance count.

terms.definition: Planar area of an individual upper-lamina window opening bounded by adjacent longitudinal ridges and transverse crossribs.
terms.label: window area

terms.definition: Protein-coding exonic sequence targeted for frameshift/null knockout or overexpression.
terms.label: coding exon

terms.definition: Non-coding DNA regulatory sequence controlling spatiotemporal transcription of a nearby gene.
terms.label: cis-regulatory element (CRE)

terms.definition: Cis-regulatory DNA element activating transcription in specific tissues or developmental stages.
terms.label: enhancer

terms.definition: Core transcription initiation region upstream of a gene transcription start site.
terms.label: promoter

terms.definition: Cis-regulatory DNA element recruiting transcriptional repressors to suppress target gene expression.
terms.label: silencer

terms.definition: Functional RNA locus not translated into a canonical polypeptide.
terms.label: non-coding RNA

terms.definition: Long non-coding RNA transcript (>200 nt) regulating chromatin or wing pattern genes.
terms.label: long non-coding RNA (lncRNA)

terms.definition: Short (~22 nt) non-coding RNA mediating post-transcriptional mRNA repression.
terms.label: microRNA (miRNA)

terms.definition: Recombination-suppressed chromosomal rearrangement locking co-adapted mimetic or dimorphic wing alleles.
terms.label: chromosomal inversion / supergene

terms.definition: Exogenous promoter/enhancer-driven fluorescent or enzymatic reporter construct integrated into the genome.
terms.label: transgene reporter

terms.definition: Chimeric G0 crispant carrying clonal mutant and wild-type somatic patches within the same wing.
terms.label: G0 somatic mosaic

terms.definition: Diploid individual carrying one mutant and one wild-type allele at the target locus.
terms.label: heterozygous

terms.definition: Germline-transmitted individual carrying two loss-of-function mutant alleles across all cells.
terms.label: homozygous null

terms.definition: Dominant or ectopic activation allele driving elevated or mislocalized expression.
terms.label: gain-of-function / overexpression

terms.definition: Post-transcriptional hypomorphic transcript depletion via dsRNA/siRNA electroporation or injection.
terms.label: RNAi knockdown

terms.definition: Naturally segregating population or morph allele (e.g., Alba female polymorphism, mimetic race).
terms.label: natural polymorphism

terms.definition: Sequence-specific DNA-binding transcriptional regulator governing wing patterning, sex dimorphism, or scale differentiation.
terms.label: transcription factor

terms.definition: Extracellular morphogen, receptor, or intracellular transducer mediating wing patterning and planar cell polarity.
terms.label: signaling pathway component

terms.definition: Enzyme or transporter governing melanin, pterin, ommochrome, or papiliochrome synthesis and deposition.
terms.label: pigment biosynthesis & transport

terms.definition: Actin/microtubule regulator, kinase, or chitin/cuticle structural protein shaping scale ridges, crossribs, and lamellae.
terms.label: cytoskeleton & cuticle morphogenesis

terms.definition: lncRNA or miRNA locus directly regulating wing scale color and pattern fate.
terms.label: non-coding RNA regulator

terms.definition: Hox transcription factor marking specific wing/scale precursor subpopulations and eyespot centers.
terms.label: Antennapedia (Antp)

holds_under: ridges are parallel and periodically spaced across the measured region
formulas.statement: Linear ridge density (number of parallel ridges per unit width) is the reciprocal of ridge spacing d.
assumes: ridges are parallel and periodically spaced across the measured region
formulas.does_not_apply: disordered or branching ridges without a well-defined mean spacing

cites.text: Standard spatial frequency definition (f0 = 1/d) used in 2D FFT ridge spacing analysis (McDougal et al. 2021, PNAS 118:e2112009118).

holds_under: tilt axis parallel to longitudinal ridges
formulas.statement: Apparent ridge spacing d_app in a planar SEM tilted by angle theta (radians) around the ridge axis is foreshortened by cos(theta).
assumes: tilt axis parallel to longitudinal ridges
formulas.does_not_apply: curved scales or tilt around an axis perpendicular to the ridges

cites.text: Standard orthographic foreshortening projection for tilted scanning electron microscopy.

formulas.statement: Real-space grating period d from first-order small-angle X-ray scattering (SAXS) wavevector peak q.
assumes: first-order Bragg peak (m = 1) of a periodic 1D grating
formulas.does_not_apply: higher-order harmonics without harmonic index or disordered non-periodic scatterers

cites.text: Small-angle X-ray scattering grating period d = 2*pi/q (Parnell et al. 2018, J. R. Soc. Interface 15:20170948).

holds_under: clamped boundary conditions at parallel actin bundles
formulas.statement: Critical biaxial compressive growth strain g_c for clamped Föppl–von Kármán plate buckling of a scale plasma membrane of thickness h between parallel actin bundles separated by distance L.
assumes: clamped boundary conditions at parallel actin bundles
formulas.does_not_apply: post-buckling large-deflection regime or unattached actin bundles

cites.text: Equation 4 of Totz et al. 2024, Cell Reports Physical Science 5:102063.

holds_under: normal incidence optical path difference between ridge chitin and surrounding air
formulas.statement: Constructive interference peak wavelength lambda of a chitinous scale ridge of height h and refractive index n_r in air (n_a) at interference order m.
assumes: normal incidence optical path difference between ridge chitin and surrounding air
formulas.does_not_apply: multilayer Bragg stacks or pigmenary absorption-dominated spectra

cites.text: Ridge height phase-interference model in Finet et al. 2026, iScience 29:115374.

formulas.statement: Approximate planar wing scale area A as product of total scale length L_s and midpoint width W_s.
formulas.does_not_apply: deeply forked or highly tapered hair-like scales

cites.text: Scale area definition (area = length * midpoint.width) in SEM_ANALYSIS_LLOYD_2024.R (Lloyd et al. 2024, Nat. Commun. 15:4079).

holds_under: constant ectotherm rearing temperature across the pupal cohort
formulas.statement: Relative pupal developmental stage (%) equals post-pupation elapsed time divided by total pupal duration at the rearing temperature, times 100.
assumes: constant ectotherm rearing temperature across the pupal cohort
formulas.does_not_apply: diapausing pupae or fluctuating thermal regimes where developmental rate is non-linear

cites.text: Normalized percentage of total pupal development (% APF) used across Lepidoptera morphogenesis (Seah et al. 2023 eLife 12:e89082; Totz et al. 2024 Cell Rep Phys Sci 5:102063).

holds_under: all injected eggs are tracked through hatching
formulas.statement: G0 CRISPR embryonic hatching rate equals the number of hatched larvae divided by the number of injected eggs.
assumes: all injected eggs are tracked through hatching
formulas.does_not_apply: unrecorded egg mortality or pooled multi-sgRNA batches without per-batch denominators

cites.text: Standard CRISPR-Cas9 embryonic microinjection viability metric in Lepidoptera (Martin et al. 2020; Loh et al. 2025, PLOS Biol 23:e3003233).

holds_under: larval rearing conditions are consistent across cohorts
formulas.statement: G0 CRISPR adult emergence rate equals the number of eclosed adults divided by the number of hatched larvae.
assumes: larval rearing conditions are consistent across cohorts
formulas.does_not_apply: embryonic-lethal knockouts where hatched larvae are not scored separately

cites.text: Standard CRISPR-Cas9 larval-to-adult survival metric in Lepidoptera mutagenesis screens.

holds_under: both wing surfaces of all emerged adults are scored consistently
formulas.statement: G0 crispant phenotypic penetrance equals the number of emerged adults exhibiting the target mosaic wing phenotype divided by total emerged adults.
assumes: both wing surfaces of all emerged adults are scored consistently
formulas.does_not_apply: sex-limited phenotypes unless the denominator is restricted to the informative sex

cites.text: CRISPR G0 mosaic penetrance definition (Loh et al. 2025, PLOS Biol 23:e3003233).

formulas.statement: Linear expression fold change FC between target and reference cell populations equals 2 raised to the log2 fold change.
formulas.does_not_apply: natural-log fold changes (ln FC) reported by older Seurat v2 pipelines without base conversion

cites.text: Standard base-2 differential expression conversion used in Seurat snRNA-seq analysis (Loh et al. 2025, PLOS Biol 23:e3003233).

holds_under: p-values are sorted in ascending order and monotone step-up envelope is enforced across ranks
formulas.statement: Benjamini–Hochberg false discovery rate (FDR) step-up adjusted p-value at rank r out of m hypotheses.
assumes: p-values are sorted in ascending order and monotone step-up envelope is enforced across ranks

cites.text: Benjamini Y, Hochberg Y. Controlling the false discovery rate. J R Stat Soc B 57:289–300 (1995).

holds_under: all four contingency cells are positive and background universe is restricted to expressed genes
formulas.statement: Odds ratio testing enrichment of ChIP-seq bound genes among differentially expressed (DE) genes from a 2x2 contingency table (a=bound&DE, b=bound&notDE, c=unbound&DE, d=unbound&notDE).

cites.text: Contingency odds ratio for transcription-factor ChIP-seq and differential expression overlap (Loh et al. 2025, PLOS Biol 23:e3003233).

anchor.quote: Disruptions of arm via CRISPR-cas9 resulted in either a split eyespot or no eyespots, suggesting arm’s essential role in eyespot center cell differentiation (fig. S7, C to H).

genetic_relations.note: Mosaic arm CRISPR knockouts produced complete eyespot loss (n=1) or split double foci without ectopic venation (n=2), verified by Illumina paired-end sequencing.

anchor.quote: Defects along the wing margin were also observed in four of the arm CRISPR individuals (fig. S7, C to J).

genetic_relations.note: Four arm G0 crispants exhibited disrupted wing margins matching continuous larval and pupal (15–24 h AP) Armadillo protein accumulation along the wing margin.

genetic_relations.target_label: CSS and BSS brown scale identity and band width

anchor.quote: Functional disruption of WntA using CRISPR-cas9 resulted in the loss of brown color with ectopic orange scales appearing along the CSS and in the BSS

genetic_relations.note: 28 WntA G0 crispants showed brown-to-orange scale transformation along CSS/BSS, narrowed/distorted CSS shape, and disrupted marginal chevrons, with 0 eyespot defects.

anchor.quote: Optix was expressed in cells at the boundary of WntA domains along with expression in the eyespot orange scale cells.

genetic_relations.note: Correlative in B. anynana — supported by sharp WntA/Optix HCR3.0 boundary exclusion at 24–30 h AP and ectopic orange scales in WntA crispants (Optix HCR in WntA KO wings not assayed directly).

anchor.quote: In 18 individuals, mosaic crispant wings differentiated two eyespot centers along the proximal-distal axis (Fig. 8, C to F and H, and fig. S15, E to K).

genetic_relations.note: Larval frizzled4 is anti-colocalized with Arm/frizzled9 in intervein cells; G0 CRISPR knockout yields paired eyespots in the same wing sector without ectopic venation (n=18) plus wing margin defects (n=5).

genetic_relations.target_label: Planar cell polarity scale orientation in eyespot field

anchor.quote: Two crispants also showed defects in the orientation of the orange and black scale cells in eyespots (Fig. 8, H to J).

genetic_relations.note: Matches pupal (18–24 h AP) frizzled4 HCR3.0 expression across the eyespot field; authors propose ligand-independent PCP signaling since Wnt5/7/9/11 show no wing expression.

genetic_relations.target_label: Nuclear Armadillo in pupal eyespot foci (18–24 h AP)

anchor.quote: During the pupal stage, the nuclear presence of Arm in the foci is likely driven by the locally transcribed Wnt1.

genetic_relations.note: Correlative spatial-temporal co-expression of Wnt1 transcripts (HCR3.0 & chromogenic ISH, 18–24 h AP) and nuclear Armadillo protein (15–24 h AP) in eyespot foci.

genetic_relations.target_label: Armadillo accumulation along larval wing margin and foci

anchor.quote: However, in the larval stage, nuclear Arm at the foci is probably driven by Wnt1, Wnt6, and Wnt10 produced along the wing margin

genetic_relations.note: Correlative HCR3.0 mapping; Wnt6 is restricted to wing margin and discal spot in larval wings and exclusively to the wing margin at 18–21 h AP.

genetic_relations.target_label: Armadillo accumulation along larval wing margin and foci

anchor.quote: However, in the larval stage, nuclear Arm at the foci is probably driven by Wnt1, Wnt6, and Wnt10 produced along the wing margin

genetic_relations.note: Correlative HCR3.0 mapping; Wnt10 mirrors Wnt6 along larval wing margin/discal spot and pupal wing margin (18–21 h AP).

genetic_relations.target_label: frizzled2 (fz2) excluded from pupal CSS band

anchor.quote: frizzled2 is anti-colocalized with frizzled4 in the eyespot field, with frizzled9 in the pupal wing margin, and with WntA in the CSS band

genetic_relations.note: Correlative HCR3.0 spatial exclusion in B. anynana (Fig. 7C, Fig. 9B model), paralleling functional WntA->fz2 repression in Vanessa cardui.

anchor.quote: However, the height of the honeycombs in scales from pupae treated on 52% development was on average lower than the control

genetic_relations.note: 100 µM CK-666 pupal injection at 52% development reduced adult P. eurimedes honeycomb lattice height by 11.1% (1652.7 vs 1859.9 nm, one-sided Holm p = 0.02169); anti-Arp2 puncta colocalize with reorganizing F-actin at ~62%.

anchor.quote: However, the height of the honeycombs in scales from pupae treated on 52% development was on average lower than the control

genetic_relations.note: 100 µM CK-666 pupal injection at 52% development reduced adult P. iphidamas honeycomb lattice height by 27.0% (1410.2 vs 1931.7 nm, one-sided pooled t-test p = 4.4e-07).

anchor.quote: By 76% development, the cuticular disks appeared hollow and are surrounded by distinct bulb-like structures formed by the disintegrated F-actin bundles

genetic_relations.note: Lattice SIM time series (57%, 67%, 76%) documents linear F-actin disintegration into bulb-like rings enmeshing hollowing cuticular disks during honeycomb extrusion.

genetic_relations.target_label: Melanic scale pigmentation (black scales in Heliconius)

anchor.quote: These mosaic knock-outs, conducted in H. erato, H. charithonia, and Vanessa cardui, generated butterflies with pronounced shifts in pigmentation, consisting of scale transformations from melanic to yellow-white states

genetic_relations.note: High-penetrance (57% of adults) melanic-to-yellow/white scale transformations phenocopying the H. melpomene ivory Δ78k spontaneous deletion.

anchor.quote: we established that a biallelic deletion spanning 82/97 bp across the lncRNA first exon is sufficient to generate a strong ivory phenotype

genetic_relations.note: Compound heterozygous 82/97 bp deletions at ivory exon 1 abolish melanin across wings and body (matching [14C]-Tyrosine domains) while preserving [14C]-Tryptophan ommochrome patterns.

genetic_relations.target_label: Melanic vs reflective silver scale identity (A. incarnata)

anchor.quote: In A. incarnata, ivory mKOs resulted in scale transformations from melanic to reflective white/silver scales

genetic_relations.note: Melanic scales transform into reflective white/silver scales with ectopic upper-lamina lamination (SEM), while orange ommochrome scales lighten partially due to mixed melanin/ommochrome pigment loss.

genetic_relations.target_label: Melanic scale pigmentation (D. plexippus vein margins & wing blade)

anchor.quote: In D. plexippus ivory crispants, melanic scales again turned white, and orange scales also appeared lighter, an effect especially pronounced on ventral wing surfaces

genetic_relations.note: Conserved across ~80 MY of Nymphalidae divergence; ventral forewing distal white spots also switch from white to orange while distal orange areas switch to white.

genetic_relations.target_label: 3-OHK yellow pigment incorporation in melanic scales (Heliconius)

anchor.quote: We thus conclude that ivory acts to prevent 3-OHK incorporation into melanic scales

genetic_relations.note: In H. erato and H. charithonia ivory crispants, formerly black scales incorporate hemolymph-derived 3-hydroxykynurenine (3-OHK) yellow pigment, whereas unbanded H. erato morphs express ivory across the presumptive hindwing yellow bar to specify black.

genetic_relations.target_label: Presumptive adult melanic scales (20–35% pupal wing ISH)

anchor.quote: Expression of ivory in 30% pupal wing tissue of H. erato prefigures adult melanic scales, and mKO results in a complete loss of black scales.

genetic_relations.note: Conserved spatial prefiguring of future black scales across H. erato (banded & unbanded), H. charithonia, and V. cardui; absent from red/orange ommochrome and yellow/white scales.

genetic_relations.target_label: Pupal-wing-specific accessible H3K4me3 promoter 5' of ivory exon 1

anchor.quote: the ivory first exon is immediately 3’ of a region of differential accessibility specific to pupal wing tissues, consistent with a promoter function

genetic_relations.note: 36 h pupal hindwing ATAC-seq (H. melpomene & H. erato) plus 3-day pupal wing H3K4me3 ChIP-seq and Hi-C TAD (H. erato) confirm an active promoter rather than a cis-enhancer of cortex.

genetic_relations.target_label: Wing scale melanin pigmentation (ruled out in cortex exon 2 Δ8/Δ10nt null)

anchor.quote: In contrast, cortex germline mutant butterflies with confirmed null alleles lack any wing phenotype and exclude a color patterning role for this adjacent gene.

genetic_relations.note: Decisive negative perturbation result (0/7 genotyped G0 crispants with 63.8–98.8% indel rates and viable infertile F1 Δ8/Δ10nt nulls truncating the WD40 propeller) proving ivory lncRNA — not coding cortex — is the causal pigmentation switch.

anchor.quote: DsxF is required to maintain Bab expression at high levels in the female dorsal scale, thus feminizing the wing phenotype by preventing UVI scale differentiation.

genetic_relations.note: Dsx siRNA electroporation eliminates Bab protein in female dorsal cover scales while preserving Bab in ground scales.

anchor.quote: Female crispants showed a gain of UVI that phenocopies the male state (Fig 2A–2C′).

genetic_relations.note: Cell-autonomous conversion restricted to dorsal cover scales along sharp clonal boundaries.

anchor.quote: DsxM is specifically expressed in the dorsal cover scales and masculinizes them into spatulate states.
from canonical melanic to spatulate in DsxF mKOs, and vice-versa from spatulate to canonical in DsxM crispants

genetic_relations.target_label: UVI cover scale (1.0 µm ridge spacing)

anchor.quote: Bab-deficient cells all acquire a UVI-scale morphology including UV-iridescence and high ridge density.

genetic_relations.note: Converts both cover and ground scales in females and ground scales in males to UVI states upon pupal RNAi knockdown.

anchor.quote: the Bab locus itself shows multiple Bab ChIP peaks, suggesting it may be auto-regulated
The Dsx locus also contains multiple Bab-binding sites

genetic_relations.note: Suggests reciprocal cross-regulatory feedback between Dsx and Bab during pupal wing differentiation.

extractor_scripts.2018_Parnell/extractors/f10_saxs_reflect:
"""Bespoke extractor for Parnell et al. (2018) Figure 10 (rsif20170948-g10.jpg):
SAXS ridge spacing (nm, mean ± SD) vs maximum reflectance (%, mean ± SD) across all 7 Heliconius taxa.

Uses `find_axis_ticks` for exact tick-mark calibration, `detect_markers_matched_filter` per
species color channel to locate each hollow circular marker center, and `trace_error_arms_occluded`
to walk bidirectional horizontal (±SD SAXS ridge spacing) and vertical (±SD reflectance) error bars.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any
import numpy as np

from livinglit_lepidoptera.extract_lib import (
    detect_markers_matched_filter,
    find_axis_ticks,
    ray_dist_alpha,
    trace_error_arms_occluded,
)


# 7 Heliconius taxa with distinct RGB color signatures in Fig 10
_TAXA_SPEC = [
    # (name, rgb, perp_thr, min_alpha, search_x_nm, search_y_pct)
    ("H_sara",            (150, 32, 212),  48.0, 0.28, (700, 800),  (20, 42)),
    ("H_erato_cyrbia",    (10, 15, 215),   52.0, 0.30, (770, 860),  (10, 30)),
    ("H_eleuchia",        (10, 125, 10),   50.0, 0.28, (820, 960),  (8, 22)),
    ("H_melpomene_cythera", (8, 8, 120),   45.0, 0.35, (780, 860),  (2, 12)),
    ("H_cydno",           (148, 245, 142), 55.0, 0.25, (870, 990),  (0, 8)),
    ("H_melpomene_rosina",(242, 188, 196), 42.0, 0.28, (945, 1110), (0, 6)),
    ("H_erato_demophoon", (232, 10, 12),   50.0, 0.30, (1010, 1115),(0, 6)),
]


def extract(crop_rgb: np.ndarray, panel_id: str = "A", **_: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    ax = find_axis_ticks(
        crop_rgb,
        y_labels=[0.0, 10.0, 20.0, 30.0, 40.0],
        x_labels=[700.0, 800.0, 900.0, 1000.0, 1100.0],
        probe=(2, 7),
        tick_min_frac=0.50,
    )
    px0, py0, px1, py1 = ax["plot_box"]
    x_cal, y_cal = ax["x_cal"], ax["y_cal"]
    xr = list(x_cal.range_for_span(px0, px1, ndigits=3))
    yr = list(y_cal.range_for_span(py1, py0, ndigits=3))

    sub = crop_rgb[py0:py1, px0:px1].astype(np.float32).copy()
    h, w = sub.shape[:2]

    # Mask top-right legend box
    leg_mask = np.zeros((h, w), dtype=bool)
    leg_mask[:235, 290:] = True

    # Precompute ink masks per taxon so every other taxon acts as occluder for error-bar walking
    masks: dict[str, np.ndarray] = {}
    for name, rgb, perp_thr, min_a, _, _ in _TAXA_SPEC:
        perp, alpha = ray_dist_alpha(sub, rgb)
        sat = sub.max(axis=2) - sub.min(axis=2)
        if name == "H_melpomene_cythera":
            # Navy blue: distinct from royal blue by lower B (<165) and darkness
            m = (perp <= perp_thr) & (alpha >= min_a) & (sub[:, :, 2] > sub[:, :, 0] + 25) & (sub[:, :, 2] < 175) & (~leg_mask)
        elif name == "H_erato_cyrbia":
            # Royal blue: high B (>140), low R, low G
            m = (perp <= perp_thr) & (alpha >= min_a) & (sub[:, :, 2] > sub[:, :, 0] + 55) & (sub[:, :, 2] > 140) & (~leg_mask)
        elif name == "H_melpomene_rosina":
            # Soft pink: R > G+12, R > B+5, high brightness, distinct from bright red (G < 130)
            m = (perp <= perp_thr) & (alpha >= min_a) & (sub[:, :, 0] > sub[:, :, 1] + 10) & (sub[:, :, 1] > 125) & (sub[:, :, 2] > 130) & (~leg_mask)
        elif name == "H_erato_demophoon":
            # Bright red: R > G+70 and R > B+70
            m = (perp <= perp_thr) & (alpha >= min_a) & (sub[:, :, 0] > sub[:, :, 1] + 65) & (sub[:, :, 0] > sub[:, :, 2] + 65) & (~leg_mask)
        elif name == "H_cydno":
            # Pale mint green: G > R+20 and R > 95
            m = (perp <= perp_thr) & (alpha >= min_a) & (sub[:, :, 1] > sub[:, :, 0] + 18) & (sub[:, :, 0] > 85) & (~leg_mask)
        elif name == "H_eleuchia":
            # Dark forest green: G > R+30 and R < 110
            m = (perp <= perp_thr) & (alpha >= min_a) & (sub[:, :, 1] > sub[:, :, 0] + 30) & (sub[:, :, 0] < 110) & (~leg_mask)
        else:
            # H. sara purple: R & B both high, G low
            m = (perp <= perp_thr) & (alpha >= min_a) & (sat >= 30.0) & (~leg_mask)
        masks[name] = m

    scatter: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name, _, _, _, (sx0, sx1), (sy0, sy1) in _TAXA_SPEC:
        m = masks[name]
        occ = np.zeros((h, w), dtype=bool)
        for oname, om in masks.items():
            if oname != name:
                occ |= om

        # Search window in local crop coordinates
        c0 = max(0, int(round(x_cal.to_pixel(sx0) - px0)))
        c1 = min(w, int(round(x_cal.to_pixel(sx1) - px0)))
        r0 = max(0, int(round(y_cal.to_pixel(sy1) - py0)))
        r1 = min(h, int(round(y_cal.to_pixel(sy0) - py0)))

        # Find marker center using matched filter on a filled-disk-like neighborhood (marker diameter ~9px)
        roi_t = m[r0:r1, c0:c1]
        roi_o = occ[r0:r1, c0:c1]
        hits = detect_markers_matched_filter(
            roi_t,
            occ=roi_o,
            radius=4.0,
            shape="disk",
            min_visible=0.25,
            max_bg=0.45,
            min_score=0.05,
            min_sep_factor=2.0,
            max_markers=5,
            upsample=2,
        )
        if hits:
            # Prefer marker lying near the intersection of horizontal and vertical error arms
            best_h = max(hits, key=lambda d: d["t_frac"] * 2.0 + d["score"])
            cx = c0 + best_h["x"]
            cy = r0 + best_h["y"]
        else:
            ys_m, xs_m = np.where(roi_t)
            cx = c0 + float(np.median(xs_m))
            cy = r0 + float(np.median(ys_m))

        # Walk bidirectional horizontal & vertical ±SD error arms across occluders
        xl, xr_px, yb, yt, hidden = trace_error_arms_occluded(
            m, occ, cx, cy, max_len=140, max_gap=4, band_half=3, marker_r=4.5
        )
        # Refine marker center to midpoint of symmetric error arms when both ends are visible
        if not hidden["x_lo_hidden"] and not hidden["x_hi_hidden"] and (xr_px - xl) > 12:
            cx = 0.5 * (xl + xr_px)
        if not hidden["y_lo_hidden"] and not hidden["y_hi_hidden"] and (yb - yt) > 12:
            cy = 0.5 * (yt + yb)

        xv = round(float(x_cal.to_value(px0 + cx)), 1)
        yv = round(float(y_cal.to_value(py0 + cy)), 2)
        x_lo = round(float(x_cal.to_value(px0 + xl)), 1)
        x_hi = round(float(x_cal.to_value(px0 + xr_px)), 1)
        y_lo = round(float(y_cal.to_value(py0 + yb)), 2)
        y_hi = round(float(y_cal.to_value(py0 + yt)), 2)

        scatter[name] = {
            "x": [xv],
            "y": [yv],
            "x_lo": [x_lo],
            "x_hi": [x_hi],
            "y_lo": [y_lo],
            "y_hi": [y_hi],
            "x_sd": round(0.5 * (x_hi - x_lo), 1),
            "y_sd": round(0.5 * (y_hi - y_lo), 2),
            "x_unit": "nm",
            "y_unit": "%",
        }

    return {
        "digitized_scatter": scatter,
        "overlay_meta": {
            "plot_box": [px0, py0, px1, py1],
            "x_range": xr,
            "y_range": yr,
            "x_misfit_px": ax["x_misfit_px"],
            "y_misfit_px": ax["y_misfit_px"],
            "kind": "scatter",
        },
        "extracted_data": {
            "x_tick_misfit_px": ax["x_misfit_px"],
            "y_tick_misfit_px": ax["y_misfit_px"],
            "n_taxa": len(scatter),
        },
    }
